topic: Sanji's eyebrows flip direction only while his Germa modifications are active, and revert afterwards
title: Sanji's Eyebrows Flip When Germa Wakes Up
description: Sanji's eyebrows flipped in chapters 1031, 1077 and 1107, and each time they snapped back. What does Oda's eyebrow gauge actually track?
comment: Do Sanji's flipped eyebrows mean Germa blood is taking over, or that he now controls it?

lines.text: Sanji's eyebrows flip, and Oda never lets it last.

shot.fallback: close up of curled eyebrows on a blond cook

lines.text: His normal curl runs clockwise, to the right. His siblings' curl the other way.

shot.fallback: three brothers with matching curled brows

lines.text: Chapter 1031, fighting Queen in Wano, his dormant modifications awaken, and the brows flip to match theirs.

shot.fallback: cook facing a huge armored enemy

lines.text: Chapter 1044, he wakes up and they're back to normal.
Chapter 1077, S-Shark at Egghead. They flip again, and revert after the fight.

shot.fallback: cook kicking a shark faced robot

lines.text: Chapter 1107. He deflects Kizaru's laser with a kick, and they flip a third time.

shot.fallback: cook deflecting a beam of light with his leg

lines.text: That's the detail people missed. Three flips, and every flip is switched off again.

shot.fallback: cook staring up at a glowing admiral

lines.text: Some fans say that just means the power burns out. I don't buy it, because the brows come back every time, by choice or not.

shot.fallback: cook in a black armored suit

lines.text: My read: the Germa body is a switch, not a leash.
But a switch only matters if he's willing to flip it for himself.
Because Sanji's eyebrows flip, and Oda never lets it last.

shot.fallback: close up of a cook's face in light
